summary: At a Node queue checkpoint, drain V8 microtasks immediately after the next-tick queue finishes.

target.notes: Use the Node-compatible event-loop runtime; do not map ordering to arbitrary Task/ThreadPool scheduling.

semantics.checkpoint_order: fully drain next-tick queue, then drain V8 microtask queue
semantics.microtask_fifo: Promise reactions and queueMicrotask share the microtask queue ordering established by ASYNC rules
semantics.continuation: event-loop phases continue only after these queues are drained

caveats: This rule coordinates queues; Promise reaction creation and queueMicrotask semantics remain owned by ASYNC.
When already inside microtask draining, newly queued microtasks can precede a nextTick queued from that microtask.

tests.name: ordinary checkpoint order
tests.expected_behavior: in an ordinary CommonJS turn prints tick, p, m

tests.name: nested nextTick drains before queued promise
